description: Source code implementing epoll-based event handling for Redis, defining functions for creating, resizing, freeing, adding, deleting, and polling epoll events, along with internal data structures and external dependencies.

methods.name: aeApiCreate
methods.description: Initializes the epoll API state and associates it with the event loop.

methods.name: aeApiResize
methods.description: Resizes the internal epoll events array.

methods.name: aeApiFree
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the epoll API state.

methods.name: aeApiAddEvent
methods.description: Adds or modifies an event for a file descriptor in the epoll instance.

methods.name: aeApiDelEvent
methods.description: Removes or modifies an event for a file descriptor in the epoll instance.

methods.name: aeApiPoll
methods.description: Waits for events on the epoll instance and updates the event loop's fired events.

methods.name: aeApiName
methods.description: Returns the name of the API, 'epoll'.
